meta_description: Whites Professional Decorators Ltd in Nottingham. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decorating services. Free quotes, local team.
hero_subhead: From interior redecorating to exterior house painting, we transform your home with precision and care.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refreshed or your entire home redecorated, we handle every job with professionalism and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: We refresh living spaces with expert colour selection, surface preparation, and flawless finishes. From feature walls to full house projects, we work around your schedule.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Protect and enhance your home's exterior with quality masonry paint, wood treatment, and weatherproof finishes. We prepare surfaces properly to ensure lasting results.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Pattern selection, precise hanging, and seamless joins. We work with contemporary designs, traditional patterns, and textured finishes for a polished result.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, window frames, and fitted furniture. We sand, prime, and paint to a cabinet-maker's standard, whether modern or period properties.

services.title: Ceilings & Plasterwork
services.desc: Smooth ceiling finishes, textured coatings, and Artex removal. We repair minor cracks and prepare surfaces for a flawless look.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Offices, retail spaces, and rental properties. We work flexibly around business hours and deliver consistent, professional results across multiple rooms.

about_pullquote: We treat every home as if it were our own, never cutting corners on prep or finish.
about_para_1: Whites Professional Decorators was established over two decades ago by Paul White, a painter who saw the need for honest, skilled decorating work in Nottingham. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local team, but we've kept the same ethos: thorough preparation, quality materials, and genuine care for the finished result. We're based in Long Eaton and serve customers across Nottingham and the surrounding areas.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on repeat customers and word-of-mouth recommendations. We invest time in understanding what you want, give accurate quotes, and turn up on time with the right materials and tools. Whether you're a homeowner refreshing a bedroom or a landlord needing a full renovation, we deliver the kind of professional finish that stands the test of time.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Paul and the team came to redecorate our lounge and hallway. They were punctual, tidy, and really professional. The prep work was meticulous, and the finish is brilliant. We're very happy and wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had our whole house exterior painted last summer. They sorted out some damage to the fascia boards, primed everything properly, and the paint job has held up perfectly through the winter. Fair price and they left no mess. Top marks.
reviews.author: David L.

reviews.text: Used them for a rental property refresh before a new tenant moved in. Quick turnaround, professional, and they got the snagging done without fuss. Would definitely book them again for our next project.
reviews.author: Ruth P.
